system.description:
GM marker: this creature or object radiates Magic. Drop it on a token to mark it.

The marker shows no icon to players. It appears as a colored glow around the token — visible to the GM, and to any player whose character bears a Detection (Magic) boon.

effects.name: Detection Aura (Magic)
effects.description: Radiates Magic. Perceived only through the Detection (Magic) boon (or by the GM).
